root_cause: During a refactor that converted the country_code/provider_code dispatch logic in parse_itut_t35_metadata() into nested switch statements, the previously bounds-checked bytestream2_get_be16() call used to read provider_code was replaced by the unchecked bytestream2_get_be16u() variant for the US country_code case, without adding an explicit length check (bytestream2_get_bytes_left(&gb) < 2) beforehand. The analogous branch for the UK country code does include such a guard, but it was inconsistently omitted for the US branch, leaving a gap where attacker-controlled short payloads are read out of bounds.
